name: Echoing Grimoire
location: Sea of Flowers, south of Sea of Flowers Bloom
description: Empowers consecutive skill casts, multiplying spell and energy damage with each repeated strike.
roleSynergy: Best for burst DPS, skill-looping attackers, and breath-attack specialists.

name: Ferocious Fang
location: Berylline Vale, southeast of Berylline Vale Bloom
description: Dramatically increases raw offensive power and physical impact. Amplifies critical strike damage against debuffed enemies.
roleSynergy: Best in slot for aggressive physical attackers and flame claw brawlers.

name: Miraculous Fleece
location: Berylline Vale, southeast of Berylline Vale Bloom
description: Bestows constant passive regeneration and reinforces physical defense under heavy incoming damage.
roleSynergy: Ideal for durable front-line tanks, regen sustain builds, and support guardians.

name: Spirited Feather
location: Sea of Flowers, south of Sea of Flowers Bloom
description: Accelerates movement and action cooldowns, allowing swift repositioning and evasive counterattacks.
roleSynergy: Excellent for agility-based roamers, evasion scouts, and quick-turn strikers.

name: Fission Needles
location: Sea of Flowers, south of Sea of Flowers Bloom
description: Splinters attacks into piercing secondary projectiles, shredding enemy shields and defenses.
roleSynergy: Top tier for multi-hit attackers, projectile specialists, and shield breakers.

name: Gargantuan Horn
location: Rosetower Woods, north of Rosetower Woods Bloom
description: Massively boosts stagger and break power, quickly crumbling boss posture and poise meters.
roleSynergy: Essential for designated Breakers and heavy blunt weapon Aniimos.

name: Heartseeker Pendant
location: Rosetower Woods, north of Rosetower Woods Bloom
description: Sharpens precision strikes against vital points, dramatically increasing critical hit probability.
roleSynergy: Best for crit-focused assassins, single-target executioners, and fast DPS.

name: Heritage Amulet
location: Rosetower Woods, north of Rosetower Woods Bloom
description: Infuses the bearer with ancestral vigor, expanding maximum health pool and resisting elemental debuffs.
roleSynergy: Great for hybrid bruisers, party buffers, and high-health juggernauts.

name: Explosive Gloves
location: Nimbus Fields, underground in the northwest near Breezy Plains Branch
requirement: Requires 120 Lumin Amber to unlock the underground chamber
description: Detonates lingering debuffs on basic attack and skill impacts, creating cascading elemental blast waves.
roleSynergy: Incredible for burn-stacking DPS like Scorchhowl and explosive area-damage dealers.
